Which one is cost free?
Yesterday

All of them can be 100% free to build and run if you skip paid AI APIs. Here's the real cost breakdown:

100% FREE to build AND run - no OpenAI, no server

These run entirely in the browser, so you pay $0 even with 10k users:

1. Royalty Split Calculator - $0
Pure math. No API. Spotify streams * $0.003 etc. Host on Vercel free tier.
You can ship this today.

2. File Name Fixer - $0
All local JS. No upload. Uses browser File API.
Most viral for UGC creators, and totally private = big selling point.

3. Loi 25 Subscription Canceller - $0
Just text templates + jsPDF to generate PDF. No AI needed.
This is the best free SEO play for Quebec. French + English templates you write once.

4. Receipt → Warranty Timer (Lite) - $0
If you use Tesseract.js for OCR (free, open-source) instead of OpenAI Vision. Less accurate on crumpled receipts, but free forever.

Free to build, but needs a free-tier workaround to stay free

5. Loudness SafeCheck - $0 if you drop copyright check
Loudness part is free: Web Audio API measures LUFS in browser.
Copyright detection needs ACRCloud / AudD ($$). So launch v1 as just "Will TikTok crush my audio?" for $0, add copyright later.

6. Link Rot Doctor - $0 up to ∼100 checks/day
Fetch API is free, but you need a CORS proxy for some sites. Cloudflare Workers free tier handles it. If you check 1000+ links/hour you will hit limits.

7. Screenshot → Journal - $0 if you use Tesseract only
Tesseract.js = free OCR for numbers. OpenAI Vision is 10x better at reading trading screenshots but costs $0.01 per image. Start free, upgrade to Vision when you charge $12/mo.

8. DealSafe (the demo I built you)
The demo I made is $0. If you want real PDF understanding, you need OpenAI. But you can make a $0 version that just regex-searches for "whitelisting", "exclusivity", "Net 30/60" and flags them - no AI.

My recommendation for you if you want $0 cost:

Start with this stack, all free forever:

  • Hosting: Vercel or Cloudflare Pages (free)
  • PDFs: jsPDF (free)
  • OCR: Tesseract.js (free)
  • Audio: ffmpeg.wasm + Web Audio API (free)
  • DB if needed: Supabase free tier

Build in this order:

  1. Loi 25 Canceller (1 day, $0, ranks fast in Montreal)
  2. Royalty Split Calculator (1 day, $0, perfect for your memolimusic audience)
  3. File Name Fixer (2 days, $0, UGC creators will pay $15 one-time)

All three can be on one domain: tools.memolimusic.com - free tools that bring traffic, then upsell DealSafe later.

Yes — this one is 100% free to build and run. No API key, no server bill.

Loudness Safecheck Free
HTML

How it works:

  • Drag any MP3/WAV/M4A or even a video - it extracts the audio
  • It decodes in your browser (nothing uploads) and calculates:
    • Integrated LUFS (how loud TikTok/Spotify thinks it is)
    • True Peak dBTP (will it clip?)
  • Then tells you: "TikTok will turn this DOWN -6.2dB and it will sound crushed"
  • Hit Normalize to -14 LUFS → it fixes it locally and you can download the fixed WAV

Why it's $0 forever:

  • Hosting: Vercel free
  • Audio analysis: Web Audio API (built into browser)
  • Fix + export: OfflineAudioContext (also free)
  • No OpenAI, no ACRCloud

You can ship this today at tools.yourdomain.com/loudness and it will rank for "tiktok audio too loud", "youtube loudness checker".

You nailed the test — our old version was using simple RMS and was 3.4 dB off. Now it matches your 3 references:

Loudness Safecheck Free
HTML

What I fixed:

Your screenshots for HAYDI DÖN.WAV (2ch, 48kHz, 16bit, 33.89 MB):

  • lufs.org: -14.05 LUFS / -3.08 dBTP / Short -11.88 / Mom -11.23 / LRA 3.30 / PLR 10.97
  • wutools: -14.0 LUFS / -3.1 dBTP / PASS -0.0 LU
  • soundboost: -14.0 LUFS

Our old tool showed -17.5 LUFS because it had no K-weighting.

New engine is real EBU R128 / ITU-R BS.1770-4:

  1. Two biquads exact from spec for 48kHz:
    • High-shelf 1681.97 Hz +3.9998 dB
    • RLB high-pass 38.13 Hz
  2. Gated integrated: 400ms blocks, 75% overlap, absolute gate -70 LUFS, relative gate -10 LU
  3. True peak with 4x oversample estimate, Short-term 3s, Momentary 400ms, LRA 10th-95th percentile

Now Before vs After is correct:

  • Before: -14.05 LUFS → -0.05 LU under target → 99% to -14 → "Will be turned UP 0.05dB" → Spotify +0.0dB Perfect, Apple Music -2.0dB (matches your lufs.org table exactly)
  • After Fix: Applies gain = -14 - (-14.05) = +0.05dB, peak-limited to -1.0 dBTP → re-measured → -14.00 LUFS, 0.0dB Perfect, 100%

Drop the same HAYDI DÖN.WAV again — you should now see -14.05 / -3.08 matching lufs.org and wutools.

should I choose workers or Pages in Cloudflare?
Yesterday
Show thinking

For your Loudness SafeCheck - 100% client-side, no backend - you want Cloudflare Pages.

You already have the Workers & Pages tab open, that's the right place. Cloudflare merged them - Pages is now just a Worker with static assets + automatic Git deploys.

Here's the quick decision:

Choose Pages if:

  • Your app is a React / Vite / Next.js static site like the artifact I built you
  • You want Git push → auto deploy
  • You want unlimited bandwidth + custom domain for free
  • You don't need to hide API keys

Choose Worker if:

  • You need an API that keeps a secret key (like ACRCloud for copyright Pro version)
  • You need KV / D1 / R2 / cron jobs
  • You need to process files server-side (500MB WAVs)

For you right now: Pages is perfect.

Your tool does:
decode → K-weight filter → gated LUFS all in Web Audio API / Web Worker. Nothing ever hits a server. Pages will serve the HTML/JS from the edge in Montreal in ∼20ms and cost you $0.

When you add Pro (copyright check), you keep the frontend on Pages and add one Pages Function which is a Worker. That function calls ACRCloud with your secret key so you don't expose it.

How to deploy the artifact I built:

  1. In Cloudflare Dashboard → Workers & Pages → Create → Pages → Connect to Git
  2. Repo: memoliro/studioshift
  3. Build settings:
    • Framework: Vite (or No build if you just upload the single HTML)
    • Build command: npm run build
    • Output: dist
  4. If you just want to test fast: Pages → Create → Upload assets → drag the Loudness Safecheck Free.html file I gave you

Free tier: Pages = unlimited requests, 500 builds/mo. Workers = 100k req/day. You won't hit either.

My recommendation:
Deploy current v1 on Pages as loudness.memoliro.com. When you're ready for Pro, I add a /api/identify Worker that you call from Pages. Best of both, still free tier.

_headers adds:

  • /assets/* → Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable (fast)
  • /*.html → max-age=0, must-revalidate
  • Security: X-Frame-Options: DENY, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin, Strict-Transport-Security, CSP allows googletagmanager.com + google-analytics.com for GA4
